name: Startup India Recognition
description: DPIIT recognition of startups to avail tax benefits, easier compliance, IPR fast-track, and funding access.
eligibility: Entity incorporated as Pvt Ltd/LLP/Partnership, <=10 years old, turnover <= Rs. 100 crore, working toward innovation.
benefits: Tax exemption (80-IAC/Section 56), faster patents, self-certification, government tenders, Fund of Funds.
application_steps: Apply for DPIIT recognition with details.
Self-certify and submit; get recognition number.
